answer.rationale: Write-path p99 hit 5x starting ~30 minutes after a release, during a daily settlement peak that historically did not require emergency capacity. That timing favors a release-induced write regression over a pure surge. Rollback previously restored a stable write path without dropping customer writes (b1). Capacity headroom (b3) was a pre-peak absorb, not a proven fix for a post-deploy 5x regression, and may not restore availability if the new build is pathologically expensive. Circuit breaking would shed writes; read-replica routing does not apply to the write path. Failover is unmotivated without a regional signal. Verify b1/b3 before committing; keep the first step a small guarded rollback so settlement writes are not broadly put at risk while the cause is still dual.
